display.purpose: Operative page titles and high-level task headings.

body.purpose: Explanatory copy and supporting page text.

label.purpose: Tabs, compact navigation, metadata, and control labels.

shadows.name: board-frame
shadows.purpose: Functional separation around the active board frame.

shadows.name: analysis-panel
shadows.purpose: Restrained separation for the game analysis panel.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable transitions and animations when the user requests reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action in a sheet, challenge flow, or completed game.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 0; border-radius: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 13px 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; background: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); color: var(--accent-ink, #21321a); font: 550 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #cae5b3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-emphasis action that remains legible on a graphite sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 0; border-radius: 7px; min-height: 44px; padding: 13px 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--surface-raised, #32373b); color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); font: 550 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #383f43); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: A compact unfilled action for secondary navigation and quiet alternatives.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 0; color: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); font: 400 13px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-text-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: A username, time, or game setup field embedded in a sheet.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Your opponent<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Search by username" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 400 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; box-sizing: border-box; border: 1px solid #647074; border-radius: 6px; padding: 11px 12px; background: var(--field, #22272a); color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); font: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9ca8ab; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: The compact primary navigation keeps the active destination visible.
components.html: PlayPlayersRankings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-self: stretch; gap: 30px; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 550 14px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); } .ds-nav-link-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 16px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Pairing Sheet
components.description: The central surface for choosing a mode and time control.
components.html: Chess
components.css: .ds-pairing-sheet { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #2a2e31); color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); } .ds-pairing-tabs { display: flex; gap: 23px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #ffffff12); } .ds-tab { position: relative; border: 0; padding: 20px 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 400 12px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-active { color: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); } .ds-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: -1px; left: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-pairing-body { padding: 25px; } .ds-pairing-body h2 { margin: 0 0 18px; font: 550 22px/1.25 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-time-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-time { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; padding: 18px 4px 15px; display: grid; gap: 7px; background: var(--surface-raised, #32373b); color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); cursor: pointer; } .ds-time:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #383f43); } .ds-time-active { border-color: #b9d5a175; background: #b9d5a10d; color: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); } .ds-time strong { font: 500 24px/1.1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-time small { color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 400 11px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Game Picker
components.description: The vertical selector that keeps all six game choices close to pairing.
components.css: .ds-game-picker { width: 100%; min-height: 78px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 15px 13px; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-game-picker:hover { background: #ffffff06; color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); } .ds-game-picker-active { background: #b9d5a111; color: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); } .ds-game-picker strong, .ds-game-picker small { display: block; } .ds-game-picker strong { color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); font: 550 13px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-game-picker small { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 400 11px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-game-icon { width: 30px; color: currentColor; font-size: 28px; } .ds-picker-arrow { margin-left: auto; font-size: 20px; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-game-picker:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Match Clock
components.description: A player-strip clock that makes the active turn immediately legible.
components.css: .ds-match-player { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 0; color: var(--foreground, #e6e8e5); } .ds-avatar { width: 34px; height: 34px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #495a4a; color: #dcebd3; font: 650 12px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-player-copy { display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-player-copy strong { font: 550 14px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-player-copy small { color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 400 11px/1.35 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-clock { margin-left: auto; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 13px; background: var(--surface, #2a2e31); color: var(--muted, #a7b0b2); font: 500 34px/1 -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-clock-active { background: var(--accent-sage, #b9d5a1); color: var(--accent-ink, #21321a); }

narrative.overview:
Monumla is a quiet, practical games club: finding an opponent is the first task, and the interface keeps the boards, clocks, people, and personal record close at hand. Graphite surfaces create a calm room for play while sage actions mark the next useful move. Clear system UI type and board-inspired rows keep the product legible across six games without turning the shell into a theme park.

The visual language is dense where decisions happen and generous around the playing space. Tonal surfaces, thin dividers, and small status signals establish hierarchy without decorative glow. Desktop uses a broad club layout; mobile keeps the same priorities by stacking the workbench and making horizontally clipped data discoverable.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite ground with restrained tonal surface steps.
Sage is reserved for actions, selection, links, and active state.
System UI typography with a compact label scale and 30–42px operative page titles.
Rounded practical controls and 12px sheets, with no ornamental effects.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Sage carries action and attention; do not introduce another competing accent for ordinary interface state.

rules.name: The Clear System Type Rule
rules.body: Keep the system UI stack, modest tracking, and tabular numerals; hierarchy comes from size, weight, and spacing rather than display-face switching.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with the graphite ramp first; use a shadow only when a board, overlay, or functional sheet must separate from its immediate surface.

dos: Do use the graphite ground and tonal surface ramp to separate page, sheet, and control layers.
Do reserve sage for actions, active navigation, selected game/time states, links, presence, and meaningful positive status.
Do keep page titles within the observed 30–42px operative range and use system UI throughout.
Do make mobile stacking and horizontally scrollable rating data explicit rather than silently clipping important content.
Do preserve visible focus outlines and reduced-motion behavior for interactive controls.
donts: Don't add decorative glows, gradients, or a second bright accent to ordinary platform surfaces.
Don't replace the system type with a display face or turn labels into ornamental eyebrows.
Don't use thick borders or hard offset shadows as a default surface treatment.
Don't hide game choice, pairing, clock, or rating information when the layout becomes narrow.
